name: Ayurvedic Medicine
overview: Ayurvedic Medicine is an enthralling profession that combines old knowledge with current scientific methods to enhance overall health and well-being. The field emphasizes holistic healthcare integrating ancient wisdom with modern practices, utilizing herbal remedies, lifestyle modifications, yoga, meditation, and therapeutic treatments to restore mind-body-spirit balance.

topJobs.description: Diagnose illnesses and create personalized treatment plans using Ayurvedic principles.
Apply therapeutic treatments including herbal massages, oil therapies, and rejuvenation procedures.
Conduct research and clinical trials exploring effectiveness and safety of Ayurvedic treatments.
Formulate Ayurvedic medications, herbal supplements, and skincare products.
Offer expert guidance on personalized recommendations for diet, lifestyle, and treatments.

institutesIndia: Banaras Hindu University (BHU) – Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh
Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences – Bangalore, Karnataka
institutesInternational: California College of Ayurveda – United States
careerLadder: Focus on high school subjects: biology, chemistry, and holistic health
Pursue undergraduate degree (BAMS or B.A.M.S. & P)
Complete standardized exams (GRE or Ayurvedic Medicine Entrance Exams)
Gain practical experience through internships and clinical rotations
Pursue postgraduate degrees (MAM or M.D. Ayurveda)
